id.description: Unique identifier within the dataset, e.g. SD-001

input.description: The user message sent to the agent under evaluation

expected_tools.description: Tool names the agent is expected to call, in any order unless expected_behavior requires strict order (not supported in MVP)

expected_arguments.description: Expected arguments for the (first) expected tool call, compared by deep equality or partial match depending on evaluator config

expected_behavior.description: answer = agent should produce expected_answer; refuse = agent should decline the request; clarify = agent should ask for missing information

requires_approval.description: True if executing the expected tool would require human approval under the Tool Registry's requires_approval flag
